items: Lifecycle: Refers to the stages a bean goes through (creation → initialization → use → destruction). 👉 Note: Detailed lifecycle stages are out of scope for this course.
Scope: Refers to how long a bean lives and who can access it during its lifecycle.
Definition: Only one instance of the class is created and used throughout the application.
Use Cases: Logging, configuration, caching, database connections.
Spring Mapping: Implemented using singleton scope.
Definition: A new instance of the class is created for every request.
